stamped-checklist:must/001.reason: All delivered workspace components sit under the common workspace root.

evidence.description: Captured Git root and workspace path.

stamped-checklist:must/002.reason: All 54 maps and metadata are included under input/ and code resolves them with workspace-relative paths.

evidence.description: Input discovery uses included, relative input paths; no submodule is required.
54 source maps and checksums are identified.

stamped-checklist:must/003.reason: No worker-supplied environment specification includes the external Python packages.

evidence.description: Imports scientific packages without a delivered environment declaration.
Rerun command points to an external prepared interpreter.

stamped-checklist:must/004.reason: At worker stop, report, code, notebook, and results were untracked; only supplied inputs were committed.

evidence.description: Analysis code is present in the capture but is not committed at worker stop.
Worker report is present but untracked at stop.
Stop receipt SHA-256 d99f296419a1ebc7f2467baf3d086d16ab0bce2f376fbee8179aae4feec1eded records original HEAD and complete stop inventory.

stamped-checklist:must/005.reason: Large participant maps are stored through Git annex in the captured repository.

evidence.description: Annex-backed map entries and object bytes are present in the complete capture.
Frozen large-in-annex probe reports met.

stamped-checklist:must/006.reason: A run record exists, but it does not link the results or actions to an exact environment.

evidence.description: The complete delivery includes a generated run record, but it records no environment identity.
The derived-have-records probe inspected tracked files only and marked must/006 not-applicable.

stamped-checklist:must/007.reason: report.md provides usage as an equivalent document, but not installation or environment acquisition instructions.

evidence.description: The report gives a run command but no environment installation steps; an alternate filename is acceptable under the frozen rule.

stamped-checklist:must/008.reason: The report gives a clear starting command for code/analyze.py and also identifies the notebook.

evidence.description: Reproducibility section names code/analyze.py and gives the exact entry command.
Runnable group-analysis entrypoint.

stamped-checklist:must/009.reason: The analysis script constructs inputs and outputs from its own root using relative paths.

evidence.description: Inspection of the untracked worker script confirms ROOT-relative input and results paths; the probe only scanned tracked files.

stamped-checklist:must/010.reason: Scientific dependencies are not declared in a delivered environment specification.

evidence.description: Imports nibabel, nilearn, numpy, pandas, scipy, and matplotlib.

stamped-checklist:must/011.reason: The run documents BLAS/OpenMP thread variables, but omits host OS and system-library assumptions.

evidence.description: The report documents OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS and OMP_NUM_THREADS, but no OS or system-library assumptions.

stamped-checklist:must/012.reason: No clear system-requirements or dependency list is supplied in the report or an environment specification.

evidence.description: No requirements list accompanies the documented command; the probe only scanned command patterns.
Imports external scientific packages without a supplied dependency list.

stamped-checklist:must/013.reason: No environment specification is included in version control or the captured workspace.

evidence.description: Worker stop inventory contains no environment manifest; project files are in the complete capture.

stamped-checklist:must/014.reason: No environment update or regeneration process is declared.

evidence.description: Provides a run command but no dependency update procedure.

stamped-checklist:must/015.reason: No frozen package manifest, container digest, or equivalent exact environment record is supplied.

evidence.description: Recorded output has no linked environment fingerprint.
The run-env-linked probe could not check a pin because no environment is named.

stamped-checklist:must/016.reason: No worker-supplied environment artifact is shared for recipients to use.

evidence.description: Interpreter path points outside the research object and has no shared environment artifact.

stamped-checklist:must/017.reason: The report names an interpreter for use but does not explain how a recipient obtains the environment.

evidence.description: Documents command use but not environment acquisition.

stamped-checklist:should/001.reason: Git tracks supplied inputs, but not the worker-created code, report, notebook, or results at stop.

evidence.description: Worker-created code was untracked at stop.
Stop receipt identifies worker state; SHA-256 d99f296419a1ebc7f2467baf3d086d16ab0bce2f376fbee8179aae4feec1eded.

stamped-checklist:should/002.reason: One stored run is present, but the complete delivery does not establish whether the workflow was tested repeatedly elsewhere; recurring run records would settle this.

evidence.description: One stored analysis output; no repeated test history in this artifact.

stamped-checklist:should/003.reason: Inputs, code, and results are separated into directories, but there is no environment module.

evidence.description: Code directory exists in the complete delivery but was untracked, so the probe saw only the input module.
Results are separated from code and input.

stamped-checklist:should/009.reason: N/A: all declared data and software routes are public; there is no restricted component to isolate.

evidence.description: Worker-declared public NeuroVault and GitHub routes.

stamped-checklist:should/004.reason: No captured record establishes a clean-container or clean-VM execution; a run-environment record would settle it.

evidence.description: Stored output does not identify an execution host or isolation boundary.

stamped-checklist:should/005.reason: The delivered workflow is a direct script invocation and contains no disposable-environment launcher.

evidence.description: Documents direct Python script execution.

stamped-checklist:should/006.reason: No environment specification exists to be regularly reconstituted and tested.

evidence.description: No environment specification exists; the CI probe reported not-checked because it found no recognized CI config.
ci-present result for should/006 is not-checked.

stamped-checklist:should/007.reason: No environment artifact is archived in the workspace.

evidence.description: Complete worker delivery has no environment artifact.

stamped-checklist:should/008.reason: No process for updating and tracking environment specifications is declared.

evidence.description: No dependency or environment update instructions.

stamped-checklist:may/001.reason: The independent NeuroVault dataset has a clear input boundary and per-map retrieval links in sources.json.

evidence.description: Collection identity, 54 participant map URLs and checksums are identified; the route is linked without a Git submodule, as permitted by the frozen rule.

stamped-checklist:may/002.reason: The report lists the input, code, notebook, and result artifacts, but does not explain how modules relate or can be recombined.

evidence.description: Reproducibility section lists component paths.

stamped-checklist:may/003.reason: Directory boundaries exist, but the workflow is a single script with no documented independent module update contract.

evidence.description: Single analysis script resolves all inputs and writes all outputs.

stamped-checklist:may/004.reason: No composition mechanism such as submodules or orchestration is provided.

evidence.description: One direct script command; no module composition mechanism.

stamped-checklist:may/005.reason: The report gives a reproducibility index linking the report, code, notebook, data provenance, and results.

evidence.description: Reproducibility section provides navigation to artifacts.

scope: Complete captured delivery; inspection, source-route header checks, frozen probes, one documented replay; worker stop-state attribution separate from coordinator preservation.
